text:
maria: Quick sync — we need a pragmatic rollout plan for the geo-first lift of model-v3 (EU region first). Customers asked for phased exposure, strong telemetry gates, and a clear fallback. Who wants to propose slices + rollback criteria?

kevin: I'll start. Proposal: tenant-weighted canaries (10% -> 30% -> 70%), 24-72h windows. Gate on: p95 latency, request error rate, and quality regression on our QA prompt set. If any gate trips, instant rollback to model-v2 variant.

anita: +1 on tenant-weighted. Need to add a cost throttle too — if token cost delta > 30% sustained over the window, pause ramp and revert to quantized variant.

ryan: Implementation note: infra can opt-in region routing and flag per-tenant. We'll need a short maintenance window for the first warmup because KV cache priming causes p95 spikes. Recommend canary windows include a 1-hour warmup excluded from gate evals.

oliver: SRE viewpoint: define exact alert thresholds. Suggest: p95 latency increase > 20% OR error rate > 0.5% absolute for 10m -> hard pause. For quality regressions, use automated evals: BLEU-like delta > 3 points or A/B click-through drop > 5%.

jamal: From solutions/sales: several enterprise customers expect an explicit canary opt-out for their tenants. We'll need a whitelist and a manual opt-in flag. Also they want a rollback SLA: confirm we can flip them back within 5 minutes.

maria: Good catch — add a per-tenant emergency kill switch. kevin, can you add customer opt-out to the plan and call out guardrails for manual overrides?

kevin: Yes. Here's a rough feature-flag config we can implement in Console:

```yaml
flag: geo_modelv3_eu
steps:
  - slice: 10%
    duration: 24h
  - slice: 30%
    duration: 48h
  - slice: 70%
    duration: 72h
fallback: model-v2-q4
metrics:
  - p95_latency
  - error_rate
  - qa_regression
manual_overrides: true
```

anita: Ops question: do we want A/B traffic (50/50) for quality evaluation on the first slice or just shadowing? A/B gives clearer signal but higher exposure.

kevin: Prefer A/B for the first tenant slice (10%) with traffic split 80/20 (80% new, 20% control) so we get statistically meaningful quality signals without heavy exposure. Then convert to full canary slices afterwards.

oliver: Make sure evals run on the same prompt buckets customers care about. We'll attach a focused prompt set per-customer for critical accounts and a global sample for overall health.

ryan: For rollout infra: autoscaler bump to handle model-v3 memory footprint during ramp. We'll provision +25% capacity in EU region pre-rollout, and a quickscale policy to add instances if queue > 50ms for 5m.

jamal: Legal/regulatory: Sarah, any concerns with EU-first rollout and data residency?

sarah: Quick note: no cross-border routing for EU customer data. Ensure logs and traces for EU tenants stay in EU. Otherwise fine. We'll need an audit log entry for each canary activation and manual override.

maria: Launch criteria checklist draft:
- SLO gates configured in Console
- A/B eval harness wired to QA prompt sets
- Cost throttle enabled
- Per-tenant kill switch + audit logging
- Infra capacity + warmup window set

Anita: Who owns post-launch monitoring doc? I can draft the runbook with SRE.

kevin: Assigning owners: product (kevin) for flags + rollout schedule; eng-runtime (anita) for config and cost throttle; infra (ryan) for capacity; sres (oliver) for runbook and alerts; solutions (jamal) for customer opt-outs; legal (sarah) for audit compliance.

maria: Timeline: target EU canary next Tue. If all green, global roll in 3 weeks. Approve?

oliver: :thumbsup: from SRE as long as runbook ready by EOD Monday.

anita: I'll start the config PR today.

deploy-bot: Scheduled warmup deployment window created: model-v3-eu-warmup @ 2025-03-25T09:30Z (1h).

maria: Thanks all — we'll reconvene Mon EOD for final signoff. Keep comments in this thread.
